title: REAR WINDOW LOCKS
summary: Coupe (19437) removable rear window: the lock (latch) that holds the rear window at the rear roof, screwed on from below, and the rear window weatherstrip (rear window seal) glued along the window opening. The lock gets 11c lubricant; the weatherstrip is glued with 51k adhesive. Related sheets: F17 (rear window storage), F18 (rear window glass).

parts.name: WEATHERSTRIP ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Weatherstrip assembly – rear window opening seal

materials.where: View A, under weatherstrip [1] in its channel

fastening.to: rear roof panel at the rear window opening
fastening.note: View A: screw [3] goes up from below through the lock [2] into the panel; a second hole/stud is shown at the lock's other ear.
Weatherstrip [1] runs around the rear window opening and is glued with 51k adhesive (View A).
